name: 女童印花运动两件套轻盈款
description: 宽松落肩上衣配弹力腰中裤，胸前图位点睛，穿脱方便显精神

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots and variant grid, cream beige #FBF3DC and warm white #FAF8F4 for info and trust screens, one mango-yellow #F2B705 accent panel for the closing shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte pale-grey board #EDEBE7 and light wood-plank home flooring
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single charcoal color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale for the two-piece set across the set
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent vibrant kids-sportswear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm white #FAF8F4, cream beige #FBF3DC, mango yellow accent #F2B705, charcoal ink text #222222 and one woven-stripe red #C63A2F; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end kidswear photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规展示两件套全貌
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level front view, outfit on an invisible mannequin, full set visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, a child-size two-piece outfit made of a loose knit top and matching cropped pants. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The set is displayed on an invisible mannequin, straight-on eye-level front view, both pieces fully visible and neatly pressed. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the outfit. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The outfit occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. 2K commercial e-commerce quality. Negative: no child model, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达宽松舒适的核心利益，承接主图点击
shots.camera: slight 3/4 hero angle, outfit placed on the left third of the frame
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, gentle contact shadow
shots.props: one thin-line ruler-style silhouette outline above the outfit
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The two-piece outfit shown at a slight 3/4 hero angle on the left third, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Background soft cream beige #FBF3DC, soft front-left key light with a gentle contact shadow, generous negative space on the right 40% for copy holding a headline 「{selling_point_1}」 and one short sub-line 「{selling_point_2}」 in charcoal #222222. Negative: no recognizable child face, no more than one claim, no invented measurements or fabric percentages, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the product, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 放大普通裤腰勒肚子、面料闷热的穿着痛点
shots.camera: matched split-screen framing, both panels straight-on with identical crop
shots.lighting: left panel flat and harsh, right panel soft and airy, same direction both sides
shots.background: light warm grey #F4F1EC on both panels
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond a thin center divider
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on framing and crop. Left panel: a stiff rigid pants waistband pressing into a child-size waist, cropped at the torso with hands only and no face visible, under flat harsh light conveying tightness and stuffiness. Right panel: {product} with its soft elastic waist lying relaxed and airy, conveying easy comfort under the same soft light. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background light warm grey #F4F1EC on both panels, subject occupies 50-60% per panel, no extra whitespace beyond a thin center divider, each panel carrying one short label line 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」. Negative: no recognizable child face, no bruises or fabricated injuries, no invented statistics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 让家长代入孩子日常外穿与居家活动的真实场景
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level candid follow view of a child walking, full body in frame
shots.lighting: soft daylight from a tall window on the left, 5500K, natural soft shadows
shots.background: bright home living room with warm beige wall #EFE8DE and light wood-plank floor
shots.props: a light sofa and a small potted plant at the frame edge, not covering the outfit
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, environment fills the frame edges
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} worn by a generic child model shown from behind at a walking stride through a bright home living room, face never visible. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level candid follow view, full body in frame, the outfit occupying 40-50% of the frame. Soft daylight from a tall window on the left, 5500K, natural soft shadows on light wood-plank flooring, warm beige wall #EFE8DE, a light sofa and a small potted plant at the frame edge not covering the outfit, no extra whitespace with the environment filling the frame edges. Negative: no recognizable child face, no hands covering the product, no cluttered room, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 用面料纹理微距证明亲肤透气与做工质感
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, tight zoom on the fabric surface, shallow depth of field with foreground sharp
shots.lighting: soft skimming light from the right revealing the knit grain
shots.whitespace: minimal whitespace, the fabric texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the knit fabric texture of the top with the weave clearly resolved. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Shot as an extreme close-up macro with shallow depth of field and the foreground sharp, soft skimming light from the right revealing the knit grain, matte pale-grey board background #EDEBE7. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal whitespace, the fabric texture being the subject, one short label 「{callout_3}」 near the lower corner in charcoal #222222. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking fabric, no invented fiber percentages, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 以结构化规格版式消除尺码与参数疑虑，数值留待填充
shots.camera: flat lay from a top-down 90-degree overhead angle, top folded above the pants
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: an empty two-column spec list with blank value lines and three horizontal indicator bars with empty slider markers
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 35% for the spec list
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce spec infographic for {product}, flat lay from a top-down 90-degree overhead angle with the knit top folded above the cropped pants. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadow, soft cream beige background #FBF3DC, the outfit occupying 45-50% of the frame on the left, generous negative space on the right 35% holding an empty two-column spec list with blank value lines headed 「{callout_1}」 through 「{callout_4}」 and three horizontal indicator bars with empty slider markers. All spec values stay blank for later composition. Negative: no invented measurements or size numbers, no fabric composition claims, no dense body text, no unreadable tiny text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 并列展示两个配色，帮买家快速做出选择
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, both variants on invisible mannequins at identical angle and scale
shots.lighting: identical even high-key studio light across both variants
shots.whitespace: even narrow gutters between the two variants, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product} in two colorways arranged side by side, hex-pinned as mango yellow #F2B705 and brick red #C63A2F. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both variants on invisible mannequins, straight-on eye-level at identical angle, scale and lighting, seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, the pair occupying 60-70% overall with even narrow gutters between the two variants and no extra whitespace, one small color label under each variant reading 「{callout_5}」 and 「{callout_6}」. Negative: no mixed lighting between variants, no texture loss on the darker colorway, no child model, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 用洗护图标与留空凭证位降低决策风险
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at the folded set on the left
shots.lighting: even clean high-key studio light, no harsh shadow
shots.props: a row of six empty thin-line care-symbol outline icons with blank caption lines, plus one empty blank hang-tag placeholder
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 30% for the care icon row
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce care trust screen for {product}: the two-piece set neatly folded, seen from a high 45-degree angle looking down, placed on the left and occupying 50-60% of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even clean high-key studio light with no harsh shadow, warm white background #FAF8F4, generous negative space on the right 30% holding a row of six empty thin-line care-symbol outline icons with blank caption lines 「{callout_1}」 to 「{callout_3}」 and one empty blank hang-tag placeholder near the bottom. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, test data or any wash temperature numbers, no fabricated seals, no dense certificates, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

shots.intent: 收口促单，以组合呈现与行动按钮完成转化
shots.camera: slight 3/4 group shot, top and pants grouped as one styled set
shots.lighting: even soft studio light, slightly punchier accent light on the product, soft contact shadows
shots.props: one rounded CTA button shape below the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space at the top 25% for the CTA copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product}, the knit top and cropped pants grouped as one styled set at a slight 3/4 group angle, occupying 55-60% of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even soft studio light with a slightly punchier accent light on the product and soft contact shadows, mango yellow #F2B705 accent background panel, generous negative space at the top 25% for a short headline 「{selling_point_3}」 and one rounded CTA button below the product reading 「{callout_7}」 in charcoal #222222. Negative: no invented discount numbers or countdown timers, no real price claims, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：①主图为女童运动两件套（黄色落肩七分袖上衣+黑色侧织带七分裤），配棒球帽墨镜外搭造型与促销文案；②宽松版型说明（宽H版型、遮肉显瘦话术）+上衣与裤子平铺挂拍；③胸前印花特写与坐姿图；④红色变体上身、落肩袖与不规则下摆卖点、衣架挂拍与双搭配图；⑤室内走路场景与沙发旁坐姿、产品信息区（原页商品名称/货号/成分/颜色/尺寸/价格/季节均为XXX占位）及厚薄/弹力/柔软/开档四条指数条（带标记位置）；⑥洗涤说明图标行、面料大幅近景与亲肤面料话术；⑦圆领、印花、下摆三个细节特写（双针圆领、不规则下摆文案）；⑧弹力裤腰特写（穿脱方便不勒肚子文案）。品类判定：外穿运动两件套（T恤+七分裤、运动织带、外搭棒球帽墨镜的出街造型、外穿版型话术），属母婴/童装而非内衣家居服/儿童内衣；规格表原页即为XXX占位，无尺码量级证据，判定主要依据成衣形态与外穿场景。已剥离：品牌与店铺字样、童模面容（改背影/颈部以下/平铺/隐形模特）、胸前印花的具体图文（仅保留矩形图位结构）、上市年份等促销字样、原文案原句、洗涤温度等具体数值（30度/110度等改为空白图标与空白标注行）、指数条的标记取值（改为空白滑标指示条）、规格表内容一律留空待填。
